title: Effect of polishing on the morphology of Zircaloy-4 nanostructure: formation of a novel hexagonal nanoscale pattern
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2618-2631
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA03903C, Paper
Open Access

Ghafar Ali, Maaz Khan, Shahzad Anwar, Khalid M. Alotaibi, Kashif Safeen, Akif Safeen, Sung Oh Cho
Hexagonal nanopattern formation via EP is proposed. Anodization in glycerol electrolyte (0.1 M H2O, 0.1 M NH4F) yielded a hybrid nanostructure on Zr-4. Effect of MP + CP & EP + CP treatments on the Zr-4 anodic nanostructure morphology was evaluated.
